units.source_text: 到了二条院，在都迎候的人与从明石浦回来的随从者久别重逢，

en.t: When they arrived at the Nijo estate, the people waiting in the capital and the attendants who had returned from Akashi Bay were reunited after a long separation,

units.source_text: 如在梦中，欢喜之极，相向而哭，声音极其嘈杂。

en.t: as if in a dream; overcome with joy, they faced one another and wept, and the place rang with their noisy voices.

units.source_text: 紫姬久被遗弃，自伤命薄，今日重得团圆，其乐可想而知。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had long felt abandoned and lamented her unhappy fate, so one can imagine her joy at being reunited with him today.

units.source_text: 她在这阔别期间，长得越发标致了。

en.t: During their long separation, she had grown still more beautiful.

units.source_text: 只因长期愁苦，本来密密丛丛的头发稍稍薄了些，反而更加美丽可爱了。

en.t: Only because of her long sorrow, her once thick, abundant hair had become a little thinner, yet this made her seem all the more beautiful and lovable.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“从今以后，我将永远伴着这个人儿。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, From now on, I will stay forever beside this dear one.

units.source_text: 然而明石浦上那个惜别伤离的人儿的面影，又痛苦地浮现在眼前。

en.t: Yet the image of the woman at Akashi Bay, who had grieved so deeply at their parting, painfully rose before his eyes again.

units.source_text: 总之，为了恋情，源氏公子一生一世不得安宁。

en.t: In short, because of love, Prince Genji would never know peace for as long as he lived.
